先让妙图自己的窗口能访问平台，再登录或提交。只改 Clash 节点但没让妙图走代: First make MiaoImg itself able to reach the platform, then sign in or submit. Changing a Clash node without routing MiaoImg through it is not a successful connection.
需要 Dola 开放地区的出口，例如日本、英国、东南亚；美国、加拿大、澳大利亚、: Dola needs an exit in a region where Dola is offered, such as Japan, the UK or Southeast Asia. Exits in the United States, Canada, Australia, India and mainland China land on the "region restricted" page (tested 2026-10-22: a Japan exit reached the creation page, a US exit was restricted). MiaoImg must also reach www.dola.com/chat/ and the sign-in service; Google sign-in additionally needs accounts.google.com. In Clash Verge, after choosing a node, enable System Proxy or TUN; a successful latency test does not mean the MiaoImg window uses that node.
Clash Verge 的规则模式下，GLOBAL 里选中的节点不一定就是 Do: In Clash Verge rule mode, the node selected under GLOBAL is not necessarily the group carrying Dola traffic. Confirm the matched rule or proxy group uses an accepted region, or switch to Global mode only for testing. The final check is whether the MiaoImg platform window can open Dola sign-in and the creation menu. A node name or an old latency result does not prove that it works now; a Japan node may also fail, so retest latency and open the page.
豆包通常可在中国大陆直连，优先在系统代理和 TUN 关闭时测试。若其他平台需要代: Doubao usually works directly from mainland China; test it first with System Proxy and TUN disabled. If another platform needs a proxy, use domain-based routing rather than forcing Doubao through the same exit as Dola.
确认节点延迟正常；开启系统代理或 TUN；完全关闭并重新打开平台窗口；确认页面进: Check that the node is healthy; enable System Proxy or TUN; fully close and reopen the platform window; confirm the creation page loads and the model menu can be read. Treat region restrictions, timeouts and sign-in failures separately.
页面、登录和模型菜单能正常通信即可确认网络通路，不需要先发起生成请求；真正提交时: Working page, sign-in and model-menu communication are enough to verify the network path; no generation request is required. Account quota and generation permissions are checked only when you submit.
